features: 1.43" AMOLED Display with 60Hz Dynamic Refresh – Smooth, Bright & Immersive Enjoy a premium viewing experience with the 1.43" AMOLED display and 60Hz dynamic refresh rate for fluid scrolling and vibrant visuals. Designed with a sleek round dial and Functional Crown, this smartwatch offers effortless navigation and a modern look for everyday wear.

BT Calling, AI Voice Assistant & FTS One Navigation UI Stay connected with Bluetooth Calling and AI Voice Assistant for hands-free convenience. The FTS One Navigation UI, Functional Crown, and Hotkey provide quick access to your favorite features, while alarms, stopwatch, notifications, and multiple menu styles ensure a seamless smartwatch experience.

24/7 Health Suite – Heart Rate, REM Sleep, Stress & Vitality Index Monitor your wellness throughout the day with advanced Heart Rate Monitoring, Sleep Tracking with REM analysis, Stress Monitoring, and Vitality Index insights. Additional features like Breathe Mode and Hydration Alerts help you build healthier habits and stay on top of your daily well-being.

Smart Performance with Convenient Type-C Charging Built for everyday use, the Jupiter R3 Pro keeps up with your active lifestyle. The Type-C to 2-Pin Charging Cable (Unified CC) offers reliable and convenient charging, ensuring your smartwatch is always ready for work, fitness, and daily activities.

IP68 Water Resistant, Personalized & Built for Everyday Life Featuring IP68 water resistance for dependable durability, the Jupiter R3 Pro is designed to handle daily challenges with ease. Customize your experience with multiple menu styles, intuitive controls, and a comfortable design that fits seamlessly into your routine.
